verdict.rationale: Stark Bank is a banking API platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, SDKs, llms.txt and markdown docs, but no official MCP server. Those are developer building blocks and AI-readable docs, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
